T-CASE-0.initial: Empty independent beaker centered on plate; bar placed on its bottom; heating OFF.
T-CASE-0.action: Release beaker for5 s; sweep bar through360 degrees quasistatically about vessel axis.
T-CASE-0.observable: Support polygon, vessel motion and swept bar envelope.
T-CASE-0.pass_condition: Beaker drift <=1 mm and tilt <=2 degrees; no bar-wall penetration >0.2 mm; plate does not rotate. Intended bar-bottom contact permitted.
T-CASE-0.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-CASE-1.action: Operate knob proxy to set50,300 and1500 rpm, then stop; inspect independently mapped control state and physical knob response.
T-CASE-1.observable: Knob angle, motor setpoint and heating-enable state.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: All setpoints reachable within10 rpm; heat remains disabled throughout; stop yields motor command0 within1 s. Missing knob truth blocks final geometric certification; bar efficacy not scored.
T-CASE-1.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-LOAD.condition: No errors, resources resolved and all states finite.
